Zoning Resolution Page 23-1 Twinsburg Township, Summit County, Ohio Updated January 2022 CHAPTER 23 SIGN REGULATIONS (Entire Chapter effective 11/2/2007) 23.1 Purpose. The purpose of these regulations is to promote and protect the public health, safety, and welfare by regulating existing and proposed signs. The intent is to protect property values, provide for safe vehicular and pedestrian travel, create a more attractive economic and business climate, enhance and protect the physical appearance of the Township, and preserve the scenic and natural beauty of the Township. 23.2 General Requirements for All Signs and Districts. a. Any illuminated sign shall employ only light emitting a beam of constant intensity, and no sign shall be illuminated by or contain flashing, intermittent, rotating, or moving light or lights such as search lights and beacons.
